verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              सैवं विलय करुणं सोन्मादेव तपस्विनी। उत्तरा न्यपतद्भूमौ कृपणा पुत्रगृद्धिनी॥१॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said The helpless Uttara, desirous of getting back her child, having thus bewailed, dropped down in sorrow on the earth like demented creature.

verses.sanskrit: तां तु दृष्ट्वा निपतितां हतपुत्रपरिच्छदाम्। चुक्रोश कुन्ती दुःखार्ता सर्वाश्च भरतस्त्रियः॥२॥
verses.english: Sceing the princess fallen on the earth deprived of her son and with her body uncovered, Kunti as also all the (other) Bharata-ladies, deeply afflicted, began to weep aloud.

verses.sanskrit: मुहूर्तमिव राजेन्द्र पाण्डवानां निवेशनम्। अप्रेक्षणीयमभवदार्तस्वनविनादितम्॥३॥
verses.english: Resounding with the voice of lamentation the palace of the Pandavas, O king, was soon converted into a house of sorrow where nobody could remain.

verses.sanskrit: सा मुहूर्ते च राजेन्द्र पुत्रशोकाभिपीडिता। कश्मलाभिहता वीर वैराटी त्वभवत् तदा॥४॥
verses.english: Greatly stricken with grief on account of her son, Virata's daughter, O king, seemed to be struck down for sometime by sorrow and cheerlessness.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिलभ्य तु सा संज्ञामुत्तरा भरतर्षभ। अङ्कमारोप्य तं पुत्रमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥५॥
धर्मज्ञस्य सुतः स त्वमधर्मं नावबुध्यसे। यस्त्वं वृध्णिप्रवीरस्य कुरुषे नाभिवादनम्॥६॥
verses.english: You are the child of one who knew every duty. Are you not conscious then of the sin you commit, since you do not salute this foremost one of the Vrishni's race?

verses.sanskrit: पुत्र गत्वा मम वचो ब्रूयास्त्वं पितरं त्विदम्। दुर्मरं प्राणिनां वीर कालेऽप्राप्ते कथञ्चन॥७॥
याहं त्वया विनायेह पत्या पुत्रेण चैव ह। मर्तव्ये सति जीवामि हतस्वस्तिरकिञ्चना॥८॥
verses.english: O son, going to your father tell him these words of mine, viz., It is difficult for living creatures to die before their time comes, because through refit of you, my husband, and now deprived of my child also, I am yet alive when I should die, unendued as I am with everything auspicious and everything valuable.

verses.sanskrit: अथवा धर्मराज्ञाहमनुज्ञाता महाभुज। भक्षयिष्ये विषं घोरं प्रवेक्ष्ये वा हुताशनम्॥९॥
verses.english: O mighty-armed one, with the permission of king Yudhishthira the just. I shall swallow some dreadful poison or cast myself on the burning fire.

verses.sanskrit: अथवा दुर्मरं तात यदिदं मे सहस्रधा। पतिपुत्रविहीनाया हृदयं न विदीर्यते॥१०॥
verses.english: O father, difficult of destruction is my heart since, though I am deprived of husband and child, that heart of mine does not brcak into a thousand pieces.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तिष्ठ पुत्र पश्येमां दुःखिता प्रपितामहीम्। आर्तामुपप्लुतां दीनां निमग्नां शोकसागरे॥११॥
verses.english: Rise, O son, and see this your afflicted great grandmother! She is deeply stricken with grief, bathed in tears, exceedingly cheerless, and plunged in an ocean of sorrow.

verses.sanskrit: आर्यां च पश्य पाञ्चालीं सात्वतीं च तपस्विनीम्। मां च पश्य सुदुःखार्तो व्याधविद्धां मृगीमिव॥१२॥
verses.english: See the reverend princess of Panchala, and the helpless princess of the Sattata race! Look at myself, exceedingly afflicted with grief, and resembling a deer pierced by a hunter.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तिष्ठ पश्य वदनं लोकनाथस्य धीमतः। पुण्डरीकपलाशाक्षं पुरेव चपलेक्षणम्॥१३॥
verses.english: Rise, O child, and look at the face of this king, who is gifted with great wisdom, and possessed of eyes like lotus-petals and resembling your father of restless glances.

verses.sanskrit: एवं विप्रलपन्तीं तु दृष्ट्वा निपतितां पुनः। उत्तरां तां स्त्रियः सर्वाः पुनरुत्थापयंस्ततः॥१४॥
verses.english: Seeing Uttara, whey bewailed thus, fallen on the earth, all those ladies, raising her, caused her to sit up.
verses.bhavadeepa: पुरा यथा चपलेक्षणमभिमन्युमहं पश्यामि तथा पुण्डरीकपलाशाक्षं कृष्णं पश्येति सम्बन्धः॥१३॥

verses.sanskrit: उत्थाय च पुनर्धैर्यात्तदा मत्स्यपतेः सुता। प्राञ्जलिः पुण्डरीकाक्षं भूमावेवाभ्यवादयत्॥१५॥
श्रुत्वा स तस्या विपुलं विलापं पुरुषर्षभः। उपस्पृश्य ततः कृष्णो ब्रह्मास्त्रं प्रत्यसंहरत्॥१६॥
verses.english: Hearing those heart-rending lamentations of hers, that foremost of persons touched water and withdrew the (force of the Brahmaweapon.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिजज्ञे च दाशार्हस्तत्य जीवितमच्युतः। अब्रवीच्च विशुद्धात्मा सर्वं विश्रावयञ्जगत्॥१७॥
verses.english: That hero of undecaying glory, belonging to the race of the Dasharhas, promised to revive the child. Then he of pure soul, said these words in the hearing of the whole universe, 'O Uttara, I never utter a falsehood. My words will prove true. I shall revive this child before all creatures.

verses.sanskrit: न ब्रवीम्युत्तरे मिथ्या सत्यमेतद्भविष्यति। एष सञ्जीवयाम्येनं पश्यतां सर्वदेहिनाम्॥१८॥
नोक्तपूर्वं मया मिथ्या स्वैरेष्वपि कदाचन। न च युद्धात्परावृत्तस्तथा सञ्जीवतामयम्॥१९॥
verses.english: Never before have I uttered a falschood even in just. Never have I turned back from battle. (By the merit of those deeds) let this child revive.

verses.sanskrit: यथा मे दयितो धर्मो ब्राह्मणश्च विशेषतः। अभिमन्योः सुतो जातो मृतो जीवत्वयं तथा॥२०॥
verses.english: As virtue is dear to me, as Brahmanas are especially dear to me, let Abhimanyu's son, who is born dead, revive.

verses.sanskrit: यथाहं नाभिजानामि विजये तु कदाचन। विरोधं तेन सत्येन मृतो जीवत्वयं शिशुः॥२१॥
यथा सत्यं च धर्मश्च मयि नित्यं प्रतिष्ठितौ। तथा मृतः शिशुरयं जीवतादभिमन्युजः॥२२॥
verses.english: As truth and virtue are always established in me, let this dead child of Abhimanyu revive.

verses.sanskrit: यथा कंसश्च केशी च धर्मेण निहतौ मया। तेन सत्येन बालोऽयं पुनः सञ्जीवतामयम्॥२३॥
इत्युक्तो वासुदेवेन स बालो भरतर्षभ। शनैः शनैर्महाराज प्रास्पन्दत सचेतनः॥२४॥
verses.english: After these words uttered by Vasudeva, that child, O foremost one of Bharata's family, became animal and began gradually to move, O king. were
